text:
alice: kicking off canary rollout: runtime v3.2 -> cg-9 (10%). kernel batching + eviction changes. router header-swap enabled for canary. pin api to v2.9. quiet window 23:00-01:00 UTC. stand by for quick rollback if noisy.

ben: watching dashboards. will mute autoscale and keep p95 watch.

deploy-bot: started: runtime:v3.2 -> cg-9 (10%). change_id=db-1769900000.

dana: note: v3.2 enables aggressive KV eviction by default. staging ok, but production sessions may see more cold misses.

eric: created alert rules: p50>220ms for 3m OR error_rate>0.8% (3m) => page. @sre-bot register.

sre-bot: alerts registered and routed to #eng-oncall.

ben: small 502 blip observed from router -> runtime within minute.

ben: log:
`router: upstream 502 from runtime-cg9 inst-07 session=efg789 hdr_x_rd_route=canary`

dana: sounds like the late-KV-slice race we've seen. header swap may trigger it.

alice: pause traffic shift to 0% while we validate. ben, pause.

deploy-bot: traffic_shift pause issued by alice. canary -> 0% in 5s. status=paused.

eric: recommend toggling router to preserve pre-swap header semantics for canary until runtime patch.

ben: applying router flag on canary: `routerctl set-flag preserve-header=true --env canary`. ETA ~15s.

dana: I'll back out eviction override on cg-9 and run a smoke.

alice: rollback gates updated: auto-rollback if p50>220ms for 5m OR 502 rate>0.8% for 3m. create rollback snapshot and update release notes.

ben: snapshot made: snapshot-1769900000-rollback. release note snippet posted to console: "v3.2: batching + eviction; router header-swap experimental. disabled for canary until compatibility validated."

deploy-bot: runtime v3.2 instances draining. api v2.9 pin remains.

eric: monitoring. will escalate to #incidents if thresholds met.

dana: starting staging kernel patch verification now; will report back in ~25m.

alice: decision: hold canary, flip router preserve flag, revert eviction on canary, validate patch in staging, then resume. reconvene before resuming traffic shift.
